Whether you're dropping fat, building muscle, or training for sport — we have the program, the space, and the team to get you there.

blog.title: Key Benefits of Stone Massage
blog.content:
1. Deep Muscle Relaxation: The heated stones warm up tight muscles fast, allowing the therapist to work deeper without causing pain.

2. Improves Blood Circulation: Heat expands blood vessels, which improves circulation for faster recovery.

3. Reduces Muscle Stiffness & Spasms: Hot stones help loosen stubborn areas like hamstrings or lower back.

4. Stress & Cortisol Reduction: Lowers stress hormones and promotes relaxation.

5. Helps With Back Pain: Heat penetrates deeper than regular massage alone.

6. Better Flexibility: When muscles are warm, range of motion improves.

7. Improved Sleep: Many people sleep like babies after a session.

blog.title: Kraft Gym Rules
blog.content:
To ensure a great experience for everyone, please adhere to the following rules:

- Do not bring food or glass items into the gym.
- Do not leave litter or rubbish.
- Ensure showers and toilets are left clean.
- Re-rack weights after use.
- Wipe down machines after use.
- Respect other members.
- Appropriate clothing and footwear to be worn at all times.
- Use one machine or piece of equipment at a time and allow others to use equipment in between your sets.
- Please be watchful of your belongings. We are not responsible for any loss.

blog.title: Why CrossFit is Great for Everyone
blog.content:
CrossFit is constantly varied functional movements performed at high intensity. All CrossFit workouts are based on functional movements, and these movements reflect the best aspects of gymnastics, weightlifting, running, rowing and more.

The magic is in the movement. Workouts are scaled according to an individual’s fitness level, making it perfect for anyone regardless of experience. Join our Friday classes to see what it's all about!
